review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent planning expectation for C. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, exact writable owner/test scopes, task keys, and evidence stages agree with the original specification. This does not authorize bypassing the material unresolved DEC-001 gate in paired B. The supplied implementation, declarations, package exports, and test configuration support the four-file binding scope and separate runtime/type verification; unchanged correct logic need not be edited. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY have distinct eligible members with active trusted claims for the relevant JavaScript/TypeScript, contract, state, data, asynchronous integration, consumer, failure-handling, and testing capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The configured independent reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing reviewer prerequisite. Pending legacy claims, including security.authorization, are not treated as trusted eligibility evidence or as requirements merely because they appear in member capability lists. Gold and preview releaseInput fingerprints match across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, policy, and budgets. The original specification's remaining-preparation fields describe its earlier snapshot, while the preview supplies the subsequent frozen inputs. Review is based solely on the supplied pre-candidate evidence; no candidate results, execution, independent digest recomputation, or new human attestation are claimed.
